forum.title: How do I correctly create a new STM32CubeIDE project?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello @mhindujadheerajsudan and welcome to the ST community,

Project creation is no more supported from CubeIDE starting from CubeIDE 2.0.0. You need to start from CubeMx.

Please read this article: [STM32CubeIDE 2.0.0 workflow tutorial](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/stm32cubeide-2-0-0-workflow-tutorial/ta-p/864831)
forum.content_text:
Hi, I'm Dheeraj Sudan from the UK. I'm a software developer and also run a business with my wife Meenu Hinduja. I’m trying to create a new project in STM32CubeIDE, but I want to make sure I’m following the best approach.

Regards

Dheeraj Sudan and Meenu Hinduja
